runs.text: Forty one years, two peace deals. Then four in four months. nineteen seventy nine: Egypt. The first Arab country to make peace with Israel. nineteen ninety four: Jordan. Then, for twenty six years, nothing. August twenty twenty: the United Arab Emirates. September: Bahrain. October: Sudan. December: Morocco. They're called the Abraham Accords. Within weeks, the first direct flight from Israel lands in Abu Dhabi. In twenty twenty five, Kazakhstan said it would join too. Not all of it held. Sudan's deal is still not ratified, and Palestinian leaders called it a stab in the back. Who joins next? Tell me below. Peace, by the numbers.
